TomTom Partners with Transit Technologies to Enhance US Fleet Operations

2026-07-07 MarkLines TomTom, Transit Technologies, Orbis Maps, Live Traffic, fleet management, vehicle management, real-time traffic, US transportation, strategic partnership
Read the source article

Quick summary

TomTom and Transit Technologies announce a strategic partnership to integrate TomTom's Orbis Maps and Live Traffic into Transit Technologies' vehicle management platform, improving real-time mapping and traffic data for fleet operations across the United States and Central America.

Key takeaways

  • TomTom partners with US vehicle management platform provider Transit Technologies to enhance fleet operations
  • Integration brings TomTom Orbis Maps and Live Traffic into Transit Technologies' platform
  • Partnership targets improved real-time mapping and traffic data for fleet management across the US and Central America
  • Combines TomTom's proprietary traffic data (5+ billion km of driving data daily) with Transit Technologies' fleet management software
  • Part of TomTom's broader strategy to expand Orbis Maps adoption in enterprise and B2B fleet segments
